### Added
- **`model-manager.serviceMonitor`, `agent-manager.serviceMonitor` and `cluster-manager.serviceMonitor`, `enabled: auto` by default like every other monitor of this platform** (giantswarm/giantswarm#36711). The meta chart resolves `auto` from the resolved `global.observability.metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled`, scrapes every `60s` and sets `labels."observability.giantswarm.io/tenant": giantswarm`. The connectivity chart's ingress policies of the three managers admit each chart's metrics port (`<manager>.observability.metrics.port`, `9464` by default) from the cluster entity while `<manager>.observability.metrics.enabled`, in both flavours, never the API port. `components.model-manager.versionRange` is `>=1.5.0 <2.0.0` (giantswarm/model-manager#203), `components.agent-manager.versionRange` `>=1.4.0 <2.0.0` (giantswarm/agent-manager#76) and `components.cluster-manager.versionRange` `>=0.22.0 <1.0.0` (giantswarm/cluster-manager#138), the releases that carry `serviceMonitor` and `observability.metrics`; the customer BOM pins the same versions. `make verify-managers` asserts the ports and the forwarded monitors.
